test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"parcel."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of the passage, "**part and parcel**" is a common idiom which means an essential or integral component.
 
• The passage talks about how guests are treated as an integral part of the family in Indian culture.
 
• So, '**parcel**' fits best to complete the idiom.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1.**
 
• **Correct passage**:

Indian culture treats guests as God and serves them and takes care of them as if they are a part and **parcel**__ of the family itself. Even though we don’t have anything to eat, the guests are never left hungry and are always ______ (2) ______ after by the members of the family. Elders and respect for elders is a major component in Indian culture. Elders are the ______ (3) ______ force for any family and hence the love and respect for elders comes from ______ (4) ______ and is not artificial. An individual takes blessings from his elders by touching their feet. Elders drill and ______ (5) ______ the Indian culture within us as we grow.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 - Member**: This refers to a person who belongs to a group or organization. (किसी वर्ग, क्‍लब, संगठन आदि से संबंधित व्यक्ति, पशु या वस्‍तु, किसी संगठन आदि का सदस्‍य)
 
• **Option 3 - Mate**: This can mean a friend, a partner, or a companion. (मित्र या साथी, सहकार्यकर्ता)
 
• **Option 4 - Colleague**: This refers to a person who works with you in the same profession or organization. (सहकर्मी)

43:T1314,

The correct answer is **"looked."**
